vulnerability_title: Pausing of FavorTreasury queues outstanding epochs to be executed

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: The checkEpoch modifier only requires that block.timestamp has reached nextEpochPoint and then adds one to epoch, and nextEpochPoint is startTime plus epoch times PERIOD. After a long pause, allocateSeigniorage can be called once for every missed hour, as the finding says.
patterns_found: epoch advanced by one per call instead of computed from elapsed time
issues: The reward claim through Staking.sol mentioned in the impact is in another file.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: epoch counter catches up one step per call after a pause
